fishing.about: What bites on one cast, by the water beside you (deep if any deep water is within reach) and the time of day. bite is the chance of a bite; then a catch is drawn by weight among those that fit.

keeping.about: Raw meat and fish spoil this many ticks after they were caught (carried, stored or on the ground). Cooked, smoked and dried food keeps.

drying.about: On a drying rack, raw meat and fish become these after this many ticks of dry weather (half as fast at night, twice as fast in wind or heat).

water.about: An empty container -> the same, full of water. A full one is drunk back to empty.

weapons.about: Hunting weapons: how many steps they reach, and what each shot uses up. An invention whose name has the word counts too.
